name: RDD2022 — multi-national Road Damage Dataset (CRDDC'2022)
publisher: Arya et al. / sekilab (University of Tokyo) — released via figshare
version_note: figshare article 21431547 (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.21431547.v1 per a search summary). 47,420 images, >55,000 annotations (secondary source). Test-set images are released WITHOUT annotations. RDD2020 (an earlier release, reported under a different licence) has its own card: do not assume the two share a licence. | Execution copy: Kaggle aliabdelmenam/rdd-2022 (third-party re-upload; provenance and licence of the COPY unverified; layout not assumed).

data_access.method: figshare download (large; Norway alone ≈ 9.9 GB per the project README)
data_access.kaggle: EXECUTION SOURCE: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aliabdelmenam/rdd-2022 — a THIRD-PARTY Kaggle re-upload, attached read-only under /kaggle/input and processed in place. Its directory layout, annotation format, class list, countries and splits are NOT assumed to match the official RDD2022 distribution: Notebook 05 profiles the attached copy first and requires explicit configuration. The upstream project is recorded separately as RDD2022; the uploader's own licence statement (if any) is a separate, unverified record. Nothing is downloaded or copied by this repository.

notes: This repository never redistributes the images or derived annotation files.

subset_used: India subset first (README lists India ≈ 502 MB), classes D00/D10/D20/D40, train split only (test images are unannotated); optionally one other country for cross-country checks. Hold out by index block / country, never random frames.
restrictions: Licence unresolved (BY vs BY-SA): treat as BY-SA until verified.
Do not commit images or annotation derivatives.
Faces/plates are blurred in the source; do not attempt to unblur or re-identify.

supports.how: Image modality for road issues: evaluate the provider's vision path (zero-shot) on roads/pothole (D40) and road-surface damage (cracks → category-level only), by country; optionally fine-tune a small road-damage detector (outside the V1 minimum).
caveats: Road-damage images only; says nothing about other categories.
Crack classes have no subcategory in taxonomy v1 (mapped to category 'roads' only).
Images are dashcam/phone-mounted road-survey frames, not citizen close-ups of a pothole near a school.
Same-road-sequence leakage between random image splits: hold out by country or source group.
No duplicate pairs exist in the dataset.

does_not_support.why: No before/after pairs, no repair state.

known_limitations: Six countries (Japan, India, Czech Republic, Norway, United States, China: MotorBike and Drone sources).
Annotation protocol and class balance differ by country.
privacy_notes: Faces and licence plates are blurred by the dataset authors.
expected_schema_notes: PASCAL VOC XML annotations; classes D00 longitudinal crack, D10 transverse crack, D20 alligator crack, D40 pothole (README). Directory layout is described in supplementary files; the adapter discovers `annotations/xmls/*.xml` and sibling `images/` and infers country from path components.
citation: Arya, D., et al. (2024). RDD2022: A multi-national image dataset for automatic road damage detection. Geoscience Data Journal. https://doi.org/10.1002/gdj3.260 (DOI taken from a search result; verify).
role_summary: Indian road-damage visual grounding (use the India subset first); latest RDD release.
